about: Princess Palace (B01) as a kit of reusable segments. Sizes are game metres (already x2.75). Each piece is generated ONCE and reused by repeating, mirroring, stacking or bending in the game. The two owner models (K00, K01) cost nothing.

module.note: One wall bay = 40 x 43 m. The 2,200 m front is ~55 bays per tier; all are instances of a few meshes.

style_suffix: ivory and rose marble, polished gold trim, deep cobalt and violet stained glass, gothic tracery blended with islamic geometric star patterns, isolated single architectural module, flat back, no ground, no base plate, no people, no statues, no faces, no creatures
texture_prompt: rose-to-ivory marble with polished gold mouldings and deep cobalt stained glass with gold leadwork, like the reference wall; clean edges, no dirt, no moss

pieces.name: Royal Portal Gate
pieces.slot: Level-1 side portals and roof-court doors; grand gate face if the owner prefers it to the built Rose Gate

pieces.name: Gilded Gothic Wall bay
pieces.slot: Standard bay on every tier; bent copies make the curved wings
pieces.reuse: repeat ~150x, bend in code for curved wings

pieces.name: Great lancet window bay
pieces.slot: Level-2 great windows (A001), smaller copies on level 3
pieces.prompt: tall gothic palace wall bay with one great three-light lancet window, lotus-shaped pointed head, slender pinnacle buttresses on both sides, gold tracery, twelve-petal rose above the lights, carved girih star panels in the spandrels

pieces.name: Tower drum segment
pieces.slot: Corner towers and the three great spires (840, 960, 1100 m): stack this drum
pieces.prompt: round gothic tower section, cylinder drum with eight tall lancet windows of cobalt stained glass, gold string courses at top and bottom, ribbed buttresses between the windows, seamless top and bottom so sections stack

pieces.name: Onion dome crown
pieces.slot: Top of every tower and pavilion
pieces.prompt: purple onion dome with gold ribs on a short arcaded drum, gold lotus collar, tall gold finial holding a faceted crystal lantern at the top, palace tower crown
pieces.texture_prompt: deep purple glazed dome tiles with polished gold ribs, ivory marble drum, cobalt glass arches, glowing clear crystal lantern

pieces.name: Needle spire
pieces.reuse: 3 spires plus smaller copies on pavilions
pieces.prompt: tall slender gothic needle spire, octagonal, open gold tracery and crockets climbing the edges, cobalt glass panels, ending in an eight-point gold star finial with hanging crystal pendants

pieces.name: Buttress pier with pinnacle
pieces.slot: Between bays and at every tier corner (Close-up E corner junction)
pieces.prompt: gothic buttress pier, twin colonnettes, small niche with a glass lantern, gold capital band, cluster of gold pinnacles on top

pieces.name: Crown cornice and parapet
pieces.reuse: tiles end to end along every tier top (~250x)
pieces.prompt: straight horizontal crown cornice strip for a palace wall, dentil and bead row underneath, vine-scroll frieze, pierced quatrefoil parapet, small gold finials at both ends, tileable left to right, very wide and short

pieces.name: Arcade bay, two storeys
pieces.prompt: two-storey palace arcade bay, ground floor one wide open pointed arch on lotus capital columns, upper floor stepped back with three small pointed arches and a gold balustrade, open walkway behind

pieces.name: Balcony
pieces.slot: Upper tiers and the curved wings (P02 sheet balconies)
pieces.prompt: curved palace balcony, gold balustrade with islamic star lattice, carved ivory corbels underneath, small crystal lanterns at the corners

pieces.name: Rose window panel
pieces.slot: Gate tympanum (G9), centre pavilion gable, corner pavilion upper stage
pieces.prompt: round twelve-petal gothic rose window panel, gold tracery petals, cobalt and rose stained glass, lotus keystone at the top, thin flat panel

pieces.name: Pinnacle turret cluster
pieces.prompt: small gothic turret with a slim purple cone roof and gold ribs, surrounded by four little gold pinnacles, open lancet arches

pieces.name: Grand stair flight
pieces.slot: Cascade twin flights and level-1 side stairs (L02-4)
pieces.reuse: stack and bend into the curved flights
pieces.prompt: straight flight of wide marble palace stairs with carved newel posts at the bottom and top, gold-capped balustrades on both sides with lotus balusters

pieces.name: Grand double doors
pieces.slot: Rose Gate leaves (G7b, P01-03), human-scale roof-court doors
pieces.prompt: tall pointed-arch palace double doors, gold frames, ogee panels, lotus carving at the foot, ornate gold hinge straps, closed

pieces.name: Arching support pillar
pieces.slot: Under the cliff plateaus the palace stands on: arches joining plateau to plateau and holding up their edges
pieces.reuse: repeat along every plateau edge; stack two high for taller cliffs
pieces.prompt: colossal stone viaduct arch, one tall pointed arch between two massive square pillars, carved gold bands and girih star panels on the pillars, rough natural rock at the foot, flat top deck
pieces.texture_prompt: pale rose-ivory carved marble fading into weathered grey cliff rock at the foot, thin gold bands

pieces.name: Sea pillar segment
pieces.slot: Tall pillars rising straight out of the water around the cliff
pieces.reuse: stack 3-10x per pillar; P03 dome or P05 pinnacle as the top
pieces.prompt: tall round marble column section, fluted shaft with a carved gold lotus band and a ring of small lancet niches, seamless top and bottom so sections stack
pieces.texture_prompt: ivory and rose marble with polished gold bands, wet dark stone at the lower edge

free_variants: Curved wing bays: bend K01 / P01 in code or Blender (no credits).
Tower heights: stack P02 drums (no credits).
Smaller copies: scale down P01/P03/P04 for upper tiers (no credits).
Girih star panels, lotus dado and brocade bands: textures/normal maps in the game (already built as petalTex/brocadeTex), not meshes.
Colour variants (rose pavilion, night glow): Meshy retexture of an existing mesh costs far less than a new model; only if needed.
